signal: Placer.ai integrated its foot-traffic data into Green Street's US platform in March 2026 and is expanding adoption across cities and government agencies

email.body1:
Chandlor, saw Placer.ai's data land in Green Street's US platform and the growing pull from cities and government agencies.

New demand like that usually means more inbound and in-market accounts than an SDR team can follow up on fast enough, and that is where replies slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so follow-up volume scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.subject2: 3 things in your outbound I'd change
email.body2:
Chandlor, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

When demand spikes, response speed and follow-up depth are usually the first things to slip, and that quietly caps reply rates. Our best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50-70%, mostly from faster, more personalized follow-up.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I'd make to lift your reply rate, no matter what tooling you keep.
email.body3:
Chandlor, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other high-growth SDR teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chandlor, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Keeping up with a demand spike is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team? I'll tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
